description: Cross references of a unit: the edges that start at the urn, as a list of {from, to, type}. graph_populated is always false: the citation graph is not built yet, so an empty list means unknown, not no references. Parameters: urn (a unit, article or act urn). Example: {"urn": "urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212~art5"}.
